SSD.note: Voter registration is manual on paper; no authentication service is stated.

facts.fact: The Sudan Independent, citing a July World Bank report, says nearly 90% of South Sudan's population lacked government-recognised identification of any kind, so about 10% hold one (below the 12.2 million population share of a third).

SSD.note: Nothing on who operates the ID system.
Voter registration uses paper records and chief certificates, not the ID number.
National ID card is named but nothing says it is issuing or built.
